verdict.rationale: Codex offers isolated cloud execution environments and a CLI sandbox mode that restricts file edits/command execution until approved, which functionally shields local/production systems from agent actions (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-3, codex-docs-17). However, this is general execution sandboxing rather than a dedicated 'test data' sandbox, and community reports raise doubts about whether the sandbox reliably prevents access to sensitive files (codex-comm-7, codex-comm-10).
